readout_other: forelimb EMG; visual and video scoring of forelimb motor responses (success rate)
direction_notes: Motor cortex stimulation evoked forelimb movements and EMG; success rate rose with pressure to a peak near 385 kPa and was higher at anaesthesia washout than at 0.5 % isoflurane.
safety_notes: No safety assessment performed; the authors argue MI and Ispta at the maximum pressure were below FDA limits.

exposures.label: 500 kHz stimulation of left M1 in mice at 55-550 kPa

target.label: left primary motor cortex (M1) of the forelimbs

device.model: single-element transducer, 500 kHz, 57.5 mm focal length, 41 mm active diameter

timing.protocol_description: A single pulse of 80,000 cycles (pulse duration 160 ms) repeated every 10 s (PRF = 0.1 Hz); 3 pulses per pressure step in the anaesthesia experiment and 10 pulses 10 s apart per step in the pressure experiment. Table 1 lists the stimulation duration as 10 minutes.

source_quotes.n_subjects: 10 mice aged 4 weeks were stimulated at M1 at anesthesia washout period.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: central frequency of 500 kHz, focal length of 57.5 mm and an active diameter of 41 mm.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: The applied peak negative acoustic pressure was varied from 55 kPa to 550 kPa with a step of 55 kPa.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: A pulse of 80,000 cycles forming a pulse duration of 160 ms was used
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.ispta_w_cm2: The maximum peak negative pressure (PNP) used in this study was 550 kPa $( \mathrm { M I } 0 . 8 , \mathrm { I } _ { \mathrm { s p t a } } 1 5 5 \mathrm { m W } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 } )$ .

flags.reason: Peak negative pressure was measured behind an ex vivo mouse skull in a water tank and adjusted for 12 % skull attenuation; recorded as a measurement through skull. Range is a sweep (220-440 kPa in the anaesthesia experiment).
Ispta 155 mW/cm2 is given only for the maximum 550 kPa; domain not stated.
Each trial is one 160 ms burst; paper states PRF 0.1 Hz and 'pulse duration 160 ms' (burst per trial treated as continuous per the schema rule, PRF kept in the description).
3 mice in the anaesthesia experiment and 10 mice in the pressure experiment; unclear whether the 3 are a subset of the 10. Quote supports the 10.
